reasoning.step1:
1) Document classification
- Presence of header "Rechnung", invoice number, Rechnungsdatum, line items, totals → document is an invoice.
- No exclusion keywords dominating (no "Mahnung"/"Zahlungserinnerung" header) → proceed.

2) Locate invoice-level fields
- Invoice date: "Rechnungsdatum: 15.01.2024" → Invoice.Date = "15.01.2024".
- Sender VAT ID: "Unsere USt-ID: ATU43709206" appears under sender details → Sender.VatId = "ATU43709206".

3) Locate totals and VAT
- Netto / Warenwert Netto: page 2 shows "Warenwert Netto 3.909,18" and earlier "Übertrag 3.909,18" → Net.Amount = 3.909,18 (numeric with same decimals).
- VAT rate: "Ausgangssteuer 10 % auf 3.909,18" and line item column shows "10%" → Vat.Rate = 10 (per rule: drop %).
- VAT amount: "Ausgangssteuer ... 390,92" → Vat.Amount = 390,92.
- Grand total / Endbetrag: "Endbetrag 4.300,10" → GrandTotal.Amount = 4.300,10.

4) Consistency checks
- Net 3.909,18 + VAT 390,92 = 4.300,10 matches Endbetrag → consistent.
- VAT rate 10% of 3.909,18 = 390,918 → rounded to 390,92 matches printed VAT amount.

5) No inference or missing fields
- All required schema fields found explicitly; values taken exactly as printed, preserving decimals and formatting.
